connect.title: Connect your game
connect.subtitle: Two steps to unlock the whole tool.
connect.help: Everything else (Atlas, items, crafting, villagers, Logbook) works without connecting.

ext.title: Bloomshire Companion extension
ext.body: Reads your game live from bloomshire.xyz/play: inventory, chests, gold, energy, crops and crafting timers.
ext.readOnly: It only reads: it never changes anything in your game.

guide.s1: Download the .zip (v{{version}}) and unzip it. You get a folder called bloomshire-companion.
guide.s2: Open the extensions page in a new tab:
guide.s4: Click Load unpacked and pick the bloomshire-companion folder.
guide.s5: Open your game at bloomshire.xyz/play and come back here: it syncs on its own.
guide.browsers: Brave: brave://extensions · Edge: edge://extensions. Works in any Chromium browser.
guide.updateHow: To update: replace the folder with the new one and press the ↻ reload button on the extension's card.

sign.title: Sign in with your wallet
sign.body: Unlocks Timers, Quests, Copilot, Liquidator, Odette and Radar, and keeps your game in the cloud so you see it on any device.
sign.safe: You only sign a message: no gas, no transaction and no permission to move funds. The session lasts 24 hours.

free.title: Without connecting
free.body: Mega-Atlas, Logbook, item finder, crafting, villagers and calculator.

ext.title: + Extension
ext.body: Your inventory, gold, energy and crops, live.

sign.title: + Wallet signature
sign.body: Locked modules and your game saved in the cloud.
